question: Arvana Pharma Ltd: PO unit price ₹1,200 for 1000 units; the invoice charges ₹1,218 per unit. Can the line pass the price match?
gold: No — raise PRICE_VAR. Excess ₹18,000 on a line value of ₹1,200,000; limit is the lower of 1% (₹12,000) and ₹500 = ₹500.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Decision: Hold the line — price variance above tolerance

[1] Here the PO line value is ₹12,00,000, 1% of which is ₹12,000, and the cap is ₹500, so the applicable limit is ₹500. [1] The excess of ₹18,000 is above this limit, so the line is held with exception PRICE_VAR and sent to the PO buyer, who must either amend the PO or obtain a credit note from the supplier. [1][2]
